lead: The rolling competitive intelligence data highlights active customer acquisition and platform updates across EFB, flight planning, and dispatch vendors, with Jeppesen, Lufthansa Systems, and IFS securing notable airline agreements.

insights.title: IFS secures multiple airline EFB wins including LCC carriers
insights.finding: IFS expanded its customer base for IFS EFBOne by securing agreements with fastjet, MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air), and TUS Airways.
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is an African low-cost carrier (LCC), MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) is classified as an LCC, and TUS Airways is classified as hybrid/leisure.
insights.caveat: Adoption announcements indicate selection or deployment but do not provide quantitative metrics on fleet-wide operational performance.

insights.title: Jeppesen announces major flight planning and dispatch agreements
insights.finding: Jeppesen secured long-term flight planning agreements with Korean Air and Corendon Airlines for its dispatch and EFFCore platforms.
insights.aviation_context: Korean Air operates an integrated widebody and narrowbody fleet exceeding 240 aircraft.
insights.caveat: Captured dates reflect public announcements and may follow the actual contract execution period.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems and Aviobook enhance EFB and flight bag applications
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems released Lido mPilot 7.3 with taxiway restrictions, while Aviobook launched AvioBook 26.3 featuring customizable seat swap confirmations.
insights.aviation_context: Lido mPilot and AvioBook are iOS-based Electronic Flight Bag (EFB) navigation applications used by commercial flight crews.
insights.caveat: Feature releases represent vendor-reported software updates without independent verification of operator uptake.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems explores potential divestment of Lido and NetLine units
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems is reportedly exploring the sale of its Lido and NetLine business units for approximately €1bn.
insights.aviation_context: Lido and NetLine cover flight planning, navigation, and crew management software utilized across global airlines.
insights.caveat: Reports are based on financial press leaks and do not confirm a finalized transaction.

insights.title: Navblue expands TransNusa collaboration on Skywise platform
insights.finding: TransNusa expanded its collaboration with Navblue to integrate Skywise Core X2 and Fleet Performance+ across its operations.
insights.aviation_context: TransNusa operates regional and narrowbody jet routes in Indonesia.
insights.caveat: Captured text indicates agreement signing without specific fleet roll-out completion dates.
